folds.title: Tokens
points: A **token** is a small piece of text, often a word or part of one.
Claude reads and writes in tokens.
Your messages, Claude's replies and files all count.
Usage limits are counted in tokens too.

folds.title: Words into tokens
points: `unbelievable` may be split into a few.
folds.note: So long messages and big files use more tokens.

folds.title: The context window
points: The **context window** is Claude's desk for one chat.
Everything in the chat has to fit on it.
Claude re-reads it all with each message.

folds.title: When the desk is full
points: Older parts get squeezed into a summary.
Restate anything important, or start a fresh chat.

folds.title: A crowded desk

chat.you: I'm vegetarian. Help me plan a week of meals.

chat.label: Many messages later
chat.claude: How about roast chicken for Sunday?

folds.note: The early detail got lost. Remind Claude, or start a fresh chat with key facts at the top.

folds.prompt: Drag to fill Claude's desk and watch what happens.

stages.text: Plenty of room. Claude can see the whole chat.
Getting crowded. Each message now carries a lot of old chat along.
Full! Older parts get squeezed into a summary and small details may be lost.
